text:
- exact_text [string] -> equals: column="value". Example: text_value="chevrolet". Match the complete text value exactly.
- not_exact_text [string] -> does_not_equal: column!="value". Example: text_value!="chevrolet". Reject the complete text value exactly.
- contains_text [string] -> contains: column:"*value*". Example: text_value:"*chev*". Match text that contains the value.
- starts_with_text [string] -> starts_with: column:"value*". Example: text_value:"chev*". Match text that starts with the value.
- ends_with_text [string] -> ends_with: column:"*value". Example: text_value:"*let". Match text that ends with the value.
- regex_text [string] -> regex: column:"/pattern/". Example: text_value:"/chev.*/". Match text with a regular expression.
- contains_empty_text [string] -> is_not_null: column:"**". Example: text_value:"**". Match every non-null text value.
- empty_text [string] -> is_empty: column:"". Example: text_value:"". Match the empty string.
- scalar_equal [integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> ==: column=value. Example: quantity=4. Match an equal typed scalar value.
- scalar_not_equal [integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> !=: column!=value. Example: quantity!=4. Reject an equal typed scalar value.
- greater_than [integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> >: column>value. Example: quantity>4. Match a typed scalar value above the bound.
- greater_than_or_equal [integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> >=: column>=value. Example: quantity>=4. Match a typed scalar value on or above the bound.
- less_than [integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> <: column<value. Example: quantity<4. Match a typed scalar value below the bound.
- less_than_or_equal [integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> <=: column<=value. Example: quantity<=4. Match a typed scalar value on or below the bound.
- in_list [string, integer, number] -> in: column:(value1,value2). Example: text_value:("chevrolet","ford"). Match one value from an exact, non-null list.
- not_in_list [string, integer, number] -> not_in: NOT column:(value1,value2). Example: NOT text_value:("chevrolet","ford"). Reject every value from an exact, non-null list.
- is_null [string, boolean, integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> is_null: column:null or column:"null". Example: text_value:null. Match a missing value. The colon form reserves quoted null too; use column="null" to match that exact text.
- is_not_null [string, boolean, integer, number, date, datetime, time] -> is_not_null: NOT column:null. Example: NOT text_value:null. Match a present value.
- boolean_true [boolean] -> is_true: column:true. Example: active:true. Match the boolean value true.
- boolean_false [boolean] -> is_false: column:false. Example: active:false. Match the boolean value false.
